sloka: एवमस्त्रविदां श्रेष्ठः सत्यवान् बलवानपि ।किमर्थमस्त्रं रक्षस्सु न योजयति राघवः ।। ५.३८.४३।।।।
transliteration: evamastravidāṁ śreṣṭhaḥ satyavān balavānapi ।kimarthamastraṁ rakṣassu na yojayati rāghavaḥ ।। 5.38.43।।।।

translations.english: 'Even though you are an expert in the use of weapons, truthful and strong. (Yet) why are you not using weapons aganst the demons?'
